title: dircue map comparison document
description: Output of 'dircue map compare --json'. Compares two dircue map documents by stable node and edge IDs without re-reading either source tree.

status.description: Whether any material changes were found between base and head.

source_binding.description: Whether both maps were produced from the same source binding (commit, digest, or neither).

observer_compatibility.description: Whether both maps were produced by the same dircue version.

added.description: Number of entities present in head but not base.

removed.description: Number of entities present in base but not head.

changed.description: Number of entities present in both maps but with changed fields.

unchanged.description: Number of entities present in both maps with no field changes.

material.description: Number of changes classified as material (source-content driven, not coverage-driven).

indeterminate_removal.description: Number of removals that could not be confirmed as real because head coverage is incomplete.

changes.description: Per-entity changes ordered by entity type then ID.

provider_status.description: Whether the set of attached tool-run providers is the same in both maps.

provider_changes.description: Changes to provider tool-run nodes specifically.

coverage_changes.description: Per-question coverage status changes between base and head.

coverage_ledger_status.description: Whether the coverage ledger (attached provider report coverage) is the same in both maps.

caveats.description: Human-readable caveats about the comparison result, such as incomplete coverage preventing confirmed removals.

revision.description: Git revision reference (e.g. HEAD, branch name).

tree.description: Git tree hash for the resolved commit.

entity.description: Whether this change is on a node or an edge.

kind.description: Node kind or edge type (omitted for unchanged entities where kind is implicit).

status.description: How this entity changed between base and head.

fields.description: Which fields changed (null when status is added or removed).

material.description: Whether this change is material (driven by source-content, not coverage state).

certainty.description: How certain the comparison is: confirmed means both sides have complete coverage, observed means the change is real but confirmation is limited, indeterminate means coverage state prevents confirmation.

reason.description: Human-readable reason when certainty is indeterminate.

scope.description: The scope (path) to which this coverage question applies.

present.description: Whether the coverage entry is present in this map.

status.description: Coverage status: complete, partial, or unknown (omitted when not present).

tool.description: The tool name from the coverage ledger entry.

report_kind.description: The report kind emitted by the tool.

scope.description: The scope to which this ledger entry applies.

fields.description: Which fields changed (empty when status is added or removed).
